subject.title: fix(telegram): use index-based callback_data to avoid silent model drops in /model picker (fixes #98221)

question: Should Telegram replace every newly generated model callback with list-index state, or preserve current name-based callbacks and use indexing only when the 64-byte limit requires it?
rationale: Both implementations fix the reported bug with real Telegram proof, but they establish different compatibility and stale-keyboard contracts that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Use fallback-only indexing
options.body: Preserve existing name-based callbacks when they fit and use a token-bound index callback only for over-limit model IDs, minimizing new state coupling.

options.title: Land the all-index design
options.body: Accept list-dependent callbacks for every model after explicitly approving the stale-list and fingerprint-collision tradeoff.

options.title: Choose the sibling PR
options.body: If https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98230 is the preferred contract, refresh its mergeability and close this competing branch after the choice is recorded.

recommendation.title: Use fallback-only indexing
recommendation.body: Preserve existing name-based callbacks when they fit and use a token-bound index callback only for over-limit model IDs, minimizing new state coupling.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent merged work on this exact model-button surface explicitly tracked both competing callback PRs.
